prompt.project_info: Sunlit outdoor stone-shower portrait adapted from the supplied prompt and approved-adult identity reference.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult woman in her mid-20s with a toned curvy feminine physique, warm beige skin with natural pores and moisture sheen, dark-brown slicked-back wet hair, calm confident expression and the specified deep royal-blue textured triangle bikini with matching low-rise bottoms.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level mid-shot from upper thighs to above head, subject standing beneath a wall-mounted metal shower spout immediately above and behind her right shoulder, water stream and fixture in the same focal plane; weathered gray stone slabs, wet tile, clay pot with green plant and wooden spa bench.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural directional sunlight from above and slightly to the side illuminating subject, shower fixture and water equally; crisp droplets and metal highlights with soft wall shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical photorealistic 50mm lifestyle portrait at f/5.6–f/8, subject, spout and water stream sharp, realistic stone cracks, damp stains, wet floor reflections and textured fabric, no readable text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical eye-level mid-shot of a clearly adult woman in her mid-20s with a toned curvy feminine physique, warm beige skin with natural pores and moisture sheen, dark-brown slicked-back wet hair and calm confident expression, wearing a deep royal-blue textured triangle bikini with matching low-rise bottoms, standing beneath a wall-mounted metal shower spout with water falling onto her upper body, subject, fixture and stream in the same focal plane, weathered gray stone courtyard with cracks and damp stains, wet reflective tile, clay pot with green plant and wooden spa bench, natural directional sunlight, crisp droplets and metal highlights, realistic editorial lifestyle photography, no readable text or logos.
